# What should I charge per seat when a class only runs if enough people sign up?

> Free class price optimizer for tutoring centers, music schools, studios and workshops: enter past prices and sign-ups, set capacity, minimum to run and costs, and get the per-seat price with the highest expected profit. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
